license_required.quote: no person shall engage in the business of being a building contractor within the unincorporated areas of any county that has adopted a licensing program created pursuant to this section unless the person holds a valid license issued or recognized by the county in accordance with the requirements of this section.
license_required.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

issuing_authority.value: County (any county or city and county in the state)
issuing_authority.quote: any county that has adopted a building code may establish a licensing program to require a person who engages in the business of being a building contractor within the unincorporated areas of the county to obtain a license from the county prior to engaging in the business.
issuing_authority.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

exams.name: Nationally recognized examination promulgated by the International Code Council
exams.notes: Examination is an optional component a county MAY include in its licensing program; it is not mandated by the state statute itself.
exams.quote: A requirement that the building contractor achieve a passing grade on a nationally recognized examination promulgated by the international code council that is commonly used and accepted in the industry
exams.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

available.quote: any county that establishes a licensing program pursuant to this section shall issue a license to a building contractor holding a valid license issued by another county or municipality in the state without requiring the building contractor to take or achieve a passing grade on any examination conducted by the county
available.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

requirements.value: A county must issue a license to a contractor holding a valid license from another county or municipality in the state, without requiring re-examination, if the prior license required passage of a nationally recognized ICC examination. The fee for such reciprocal issuance is limited to reasonable processing costs.
requirements.quote: any county that establishes a licensing program pursuant to this section shall issue a license to a building contractor holding a valid license issued by another county or municipality in the state without requiring the building contractor to take or achieve a passing grade on any examination conducted by the county if the license issued by such other county or municipality required the building contractor to achieve a passing grade on a nationally recognized examination promulgated by the international code council commonly used and accepted in the industry.
requirements.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

disciplinary_grounds.description: Grounds for revocation or suspension of a license when the contractor is found not to be in compliance with the county's licensing requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grounds for the revocation or suspension of a license issued by the county, grounds for the revocation or suspension of a building permit issued for a project for which the building contractor is found not to be in compliance with the county's licensing requirements, or grounds for the imposition of any lesser sanction, which shall be based on objective standards and criteria developed from the county building code
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Title 30, Article 11, Part 1 - Licensing Program for Building Contractors

definition_quote.value: a building contractor who for compensation directs, supervises, or undertakes any work for which a county building permit is required
definition_quote.quote: "Building contractor" means a building contractor who for compensation directs, supervises, or undertakes any work for which a county building permit is required.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: "Building contractor" shall not include an electrician required to be licensed by the state pursuant to article 115 of title 12 or a plumber required to be licensed by the state pursuant to article 155 of title 12.
